en.headline: Man jailed three years over hammer attack after victim dies of overdose
en.dek: Mo Tai-fung, 42, was sentenced at the High Court after prosecutors amended an initial murder charge; an autopsy found the victim died from drug effects rather than the injuries.
body: The High Court on Tuesday sentenced Mo Tai-fung, 42, to three years and two months in prison for attacking an associate with a hammer in Yau Ma Tei in July 2024.

Mo had initially faced a murder charge after striking the 33-year-old victim, surnamed Pang, on the head 11 times outside a building on Pilkem Street at about 2am on 28 July 2024. Prosecutors later amended the charge after an autopsy concluded that Pang died from the effects of drugs rather than the scalp lacerations, which were not fatal.

The court heard that Mo, who has a triad background and previous convictions including for wounding, admitted wounding with intent and a related drug offence. The judge noted the deliberate nature of the attack captured on closed-circuit television and Mo’s extensive criminal record.

zh.headline: 油麻地錘擊案 男子認有意圖傷人判囚三年兩個月
zh.dek: 42歲巫泰峰去年在油麻地以鐵錘擊打同黨頭部11下，死者其後因吸毒過量身亡；高院今日判刑，控方早前已將謀殺罪改控有意圖傷人。
body: 高等法院今日判處42歲巫泰峰監禁三年兩個月，他承認於2024年7月28日凌晨在油麻地庇利金街以鐵錘襲擊一名33歲姓彭男子頭部11下，導致對方受傷。
控方原本控告謀殺，但解剖報告顯示死者頭部傷口雖然嚴重，並非致命，真正死因是吸毒後的不良反應。控方遂改控有意圖傷人及吸食危險藥物，被告認罪。
法官指出被告有三合會背景及多項包括傷人的案底，出狱後短時間內再犯，襲擊屬有備而來，閉路電視亦清楚錄下過程。
